item.title: uml-mcp — UML diagrams from chat via MCP
item.description:
[1]

uml-mcp[1] gives an MCP client real diagram tools: an assistant supplies Mermaid, PlantUML, or another supported diagram source, and the server returns rendered output and useful links. The current repository documents five tools and a catalog of roughly 37 Kroki-backed types. Those counts describe the documented interface, not a rendering benchmark.
